martial-initiate-master-upgrades.head: a33db2239ae1a1fee6e595762fafcb1b032405bc
martial-initiate-master-upgrades.scope: Stock hotbar casts applied the caster upgrades in succession. Status showed 1062 +70 max HP, +4 melee accuracy, +2 melee damage and +4 melee defense; 1063 replaced it with +90 max HP, +6 melee accuracy and +2 melee damage. The companion PacketLog 5298–5304 shows the 1062 records turn off, then 1063 activates with the +4 melee defense modifier as well.

stats.runtime: CombatStyles.Select and AbilityPassives feed ordinary attack, each typed contest defense, physical ability damage and the direct ordinary withdrawal input.
stats.test: MartialArtistSecondBatchTests.SelectedStyleFeedsTypedContestsOrdinaryWithdrawalAndDamage checks all named inputs at rank 50 and switching away. Retail ordinary melee damage and withdrawal fidelity remain open.
